I've found the email from the event organizers that mentioned a free consultation. The email contained the booking address `bookings@best-event-organizers.com`, and I've sent a request email to that address on your behalf.

The email I sent requests a free consultation as offered, and includes your introduction as Emma Johnson from Blue Sparrow Tech. The organizers should now receive your request and can respond to schedule a consultation time.
